summary: R9 Vendor Tender Builder E2E (backend pytest 21 tests + Playwright UI). Core happy path works: vendor free entitlement, full builder in vendorMode (Submit for PMC review shown, Create notice hidden), clone/save/section save, owner_vendor_id stamping, tenant isolation (2nd seeded vendor gets 404 on GET/PATCH/DELETE/versions/submit/ai-fill-all/DPR template, not listed), submit-review + lock on full PATCH, reviewer queue/approve/request-changes/reject (API + UI), notice publish (origin=vendor, author=Test Supplier Co, tender_template_id linked, approved + published_notice_ref), own-tender bid guard 403, admin 403 on review queue/approve, priced Fee Master country gate (402 writes, vendor-sub-gate UI with EUR 49), DPR async job ownership, Claude Sonnet 5.5 AI draft / fill-all / analyze-json all returned 200 on small drafts, admin builder regression (clone/save/history/PDF). FOUND 3 backend security/integrity bugs + several gaps (below).

critical.issue: Vendor can DELETE their own tender after it was submitted or APPROVED/published. delete_template only checks is_master + ownership, not review_status. Reproduced: approved VT notice remained live but /public/pdf?notice_ref=... returned 404 afterwards, so the published notice was broken.

critical.endpoint: PATCH /api/v1/tender-pro/templates/{tid}/sections/{code}, POST /tender-templates/{tid}/versions/{i}/restore, POST /tender-pro/templates/{tid}/ai-fill-all, POST /tender-templates/{tid}/sections/{code}/ai-draft + attachment upload/remove
critical.issue: The review lock (409 when review_status is submitted/approved) exists only in the full PATCH /tender-templates/{tid}. The other write paths skip it. Reproduced: the vendor's section PATCH on an APPROVED/published tender returned 200. That lets a vendor change the published tender content (public PDF renders live from the template) after the reviewer approved it.

A vendor master rejected by the reviewer (moderation_status='rejected') leaks into the SHARED master library for every vendor. The filter uses moderation_status != 'pending' when it should require approved (or a missing status for staff/seed masters). Reproduced with the 2nd vendor. The same logic also lets the public /{tid}/public/pdf|zip serve pending/rejected vendor masters, because is_master=True.

critical.endpoint: All write_principal endpoints with an admin/staff session (POST/PATCH/DELETE /tender-templates, tender-pro section/ai-fill/save-as-master/dpr)
critical.issue: CSRF regression: these routes used to depend on require_role('admin'), which enforces require_csrf. write_principal/tender_principal never call require_csrf (it is imported in _tender_access.py but unused). Reproduced: an admin cookie session created a template WITHOUT the X-CSRF-Token header and got 200.

minor.issue: No check that review_status=='submitted'. A reviewer can flip an already APPROVED/published tender to rejected/changes_requested while its notice stays published, which makes the state inconsistent.
No validation of notice-mandatory fields. A tender with an empty category, description and budget was published (notice category=None, budget_amount=None).
Runs synchronously over every section. On the 18-section master clone it went past the ingress timeout and returned a Cloudflare 502 HTML page. Needs async/job mode like DPR analyze-async.

Reads only top-level country keys (not profile.country, which current_vendor does read) and slices to 3 chars ('India'->'IND'), so it may not match Fee Master ISO-2 'IN'. If the country is missing or mismatched the vendor silently gets the builder FREE (pricing bypass). testvendor has no country, so it is always free.
Malformed ObjectId gives a 500 in get/patch/delete/submit-review (no try/except).
No brute-force lockout (6+ consecutive 401s, never 429). CORS preflight returns '*' for an arbitrary origin. Pre-existing, not R9-specific.

ui_bugs.issue: After submit (and after approval) the vendor UI shows no review-status badge. 'Submit for PMC review', Delete, AI Fill All, section Save and Save-as-master all stay enabled: re-submit gives 409 and delete actually succeeds. Show the status and disable the edit/submit/delete controls when submitted or approved.

The bulk section-attachment uploader is shown to vendors, but POST /tender-templates/{tid}/attachments/bulk is still require_role('admin'), so vendors get 401/403. Either convert it to write_principal with ownership checks or hide it in vendorMode.

integration_issues.issue: tenderTemplateApi.pendingMasters/approveMaster/rejectMaster exist in api.js but no page uses them. AdminTenderReviewE has no 'Pending masters' tab, so vendor-saved masters can never be approved from the UI.

integration_issues.flow: Reviewer queue for a non-reviewer admin
integration_issues.issue: AdminTenderReviewE swallows the 403 (.catch(()=>{})) and shows 'Nothing here.' instead of telling the admin to switch to the reviewer role.

issues: A reviewer cannot open or preview the full vendor tender (sections/PDF) before 'Approve & publish'. Only the header summary is shown. Add a View/PDF link per row.
Row meta shows '— · — · INR —' when fields are blank.

action_items: Block vendor DELETE (and every write path: section PATCH, restore, ai-fill-all, ai-draft, attachment upload/remove) when review_status in ('submitted','approved'). Centralise the check in assert_can_edit_doc.

scope_filter/assert_can_read_doc: show a vendor master only when moderation_status is approved (or missing for staff/seed masters). Exclude 'rejected'. Apply the same gate in /public/pdf and /public/zip.
Add require_csrf for admin principals in write_principal (e.g. call await require_csrf(request) when principal kind=='admin').
Guard review/request-changes and review/reject to status=='submitted'. Validate the mandatory fields (title, description, category, value, deadline) before approve publishes.
Vendor UI: show the review_status badge and disable edit/submit/delete when submitted/approved. Hide or enable the bulk upload in vendorMode.
Add a Pending masters tab to AdminTenderReviewE using pendingMasters/approveMaster/rejectMaster.
Make vendor_country also read profile.country and normalise to ISO-2 to match the Fee Master.
Consider an async job for ai-fill-all on large templates (ingress 502 on 18 sections).
critical_code_review_comments: tender_templates.py is 994 lines and should be split (review/moderation endpoints into their own module).
_tender_access.py imports require_csrf but never uses it, which is the root cause of the CSRF regression.
save_as_master clone copies every source field (published_notice_ref, owner_company_name missing, submitted_at, review_note). Whitelist the fields instead.
list_templates resolves created_by_email from db.admins while the users live in db.admin_users (likely always None, pre-existing).

success_rate.backend: 86% (18/21 pytest; the 3 failures are real bugs)
success_rate.frontend: ~85% (vendor builder, submit, reviewer approve, sub gate and admin regression work; status/lock UX and master moderation UI missing)

seed_data_creation: The pytest seeds a 2nd vendor test_r9_vendorb@pmcmanagers.com (kyc verified) and a temporary emd_masters subscription for country ZZ, and removes both in teardown. All TEST_R9 templates and VT notices were cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_r9_vendor_tender_builder.py -n 0 (it MUST run with -n 0 because of shared module state across xdist workers). The 3 expected failures map to the critical bugs above. Vendor UI login is easiest via page.request.post('/api/v1/vendor/auth/login') and then goto /vendor/tender-builder (filling the form via Playwright got reset). The LLM (claude-sonnet-5-5) works.
rca of the issue: 1) The review lock lives only in patch_template, not in a shared helper, so the other mutators and DELETE bypass it. 2) scope_filter uses $ne 'pending', which lets 'rejected' through. 3) Moving from require_role to principal deps dropped the require_csrf dependency for staff sessions.
